scientific_integrity: All-space results have analytical proofs; exact finite-state checks are supplementary. Priorities and implications assessed in accessible literature, independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly computed 1D Euler stencil followed by independent complete-step binary fixed-grid rounding, centered half-valued Dirichlet reservoirs; general result only 0<h<=1/2, two-cell extension only 0<h<2/3. Not hardware floating-point SR, correlated rounding, or higher-dimensional heat solvers.
title: Checkerboard independence at the monotone CFL edge for binary stochastic heat rounding
